verdict.rationale: uv is fundamentally a CLI tool with an extensive official CLI reference (uv-probe-4) and dozens of documented commands (init, add, remove, run, tool install/run, python pin, cache clean, self update, etc.), all first-party. Community evidence (uv-comm-1, uv-comm-2, uv-comm-6, uv-comm-10, uv-comm-15) independently corroborates hands-on CLI usage and its ergonomics. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of AI-agent-specific CLI features (e.g., machine-readable/JSON output beyond uv-docs-28) tailored to agentic workflows.
